translations.web: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
translations.bsb: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
translations.kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
